description: a young god of thunder, a young man with light skin, long fair blond hair hanging straight down his back at rest, not flying and not blowing in the wind, a handsome sharp young face, bareheaded, shining armour of polished gold with a white lightning mark on the chest over brown leather, a deep crimson hood lying on the shoulders, a long deep crimson cape hanging behind from the shoulders, golden greaves and boots, no golden wheel, no lightning around the body, no bow and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look in detail: face, hair, armour, crimson hood and cape and colours; the hands empty, without the golden wheel, the lightning and the bow
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
